text: {"question":"What is the expression for the present‑day density parameter of the trigger field in terms of the fractional energy density at the transition and the transition redshift, and how does this relate to the Hubble parameter in a flat ΛCDM model?","reference_answer":"The trigger field density is \u03a9_{\phi}\simeq0.4\Bigl(1+\frac{z_c}{5000}\Bigr)\Bigl(\frac{\phi_{\rm ini}}{M_{\rm Pl}}\Bigr)^2(1-f_{\rm NEDE}).  In a flat ΛCDM universe the Hubble rate is H(z)=H_0\sqrt{\Omega_{m0}(1+z)^3+\Omega_{r0}(1+z)^4+(1-\Omega_{m0}-\Omega_{r0})}, so the same \u03a9_{\phi} would appear as an additional constant term in the energy budget that modifies the late‑time expansion encoded in H(z)."}
